patch_description: Replace the 7-gate CZ line with 12 CZ gates: even pairs (0,1)(2,3)(4,5)(6,7), odd pairs with ring closure (1,2)(3,4)(5,6)(7,0), and long-range cross connections (0,4)(1,5)(2,6)(3,7). Replace pre-RZ with RX for better rotation diversity after IsingZZ feature encoding. Same 24 params per block (146 total) but much richer qubit connectivity, enabling faster information mixing across all 8 qubits.
